title: Grateful Dead Live at Greek Theatre, U. Of California on 1988-07-16
lineage: PCM Master (Sony SLV-M20HF) > Sony PCM-601ESD > Behringer Ultramatch Pro >Tascam DA-3000 (16-bit/44.1k) > Samplitude Pro X3 Suite > FLAC/16

ai_review.summary: Ultra‑Matrix recording sounds nice overall but suffers left‑ear distortion during Terrapin Station.
ai_review.review: The ultra‑matrix source delivers the usual clear and balanced Dead sound, making the seed pleasant to listen to. However listeners should beware of a noticeable left‑channel distortion from about 8:20–9:00 during Terrapin Station, especially when using headphones. Aside from that issue the recording is solid.

ai_rating.rationale: Only a single 4‑star review; reviewer praises overall sound but flags a specific distortion problem, leading to a moderate rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Generally clear ultra‑matrix feed, but left‑ear distortion around Terrapin Station (8:20–9:00) can be harsh on headphones.
